function: Cascaded BS-RIS-user channel estimation for hybrid near/far-field XL-RIS massive MIMO from uplink pilots, using unrolled convolutional dictionary-learning networks (p. 1, 3).
system: BS with 32-antenna ULA, passive reflecting XL-RIS UPA of 64x8 = 512 elements, single-antenna user, TDD mmWave at 10 GHz carrier (p. 3, 10).
method: Deep unfolding of ISTA/PGD: CISTA-Net (self-supervised), CISTA-Net+ and CNN-CDL (supervised, MSE loss, end-to-end training with Adam) (p. 7, 9, 10).
data_channel: Custom simulated channels: Saleh-Valenzuela BS-RIS link, hybrid far/near-field RIS-user link with 6 random paths; 5x10^7 pairs per SNR split 3.5/0.5/1.0 x10^7 train/val/test (p. 4, 10).
test_conditions: Train/test on same simulated setup (512 RIS elements, 32 antennas, 256 pilots); also trained on [3,3] far/near path split and tested on other splits (p. 10, 12).
baselines: Non-learned: OMP with predefined dictionary, oracle least squares; learned: ISTA-Net+ (unrolled ISTA), D2-CNN (data-driven CNN) (p. 10).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR, pilots, path configuration and unrolled layers; spectral efficiency versus transmit power with estimated channels (p. 10-12).
complexity: FLOPs via fvcore (Table I): CNN-CDL 25.42e9, CISTA-Net+ 0.54e9, OMP 0.51e9; dictionary sizes, e.g. CNN-CDL 1,186x5x2 parameters (p. 10).
openness: none; the only link is the third-party fvcore library used for FLOP counting, no code or data of the method is released (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 4: "the channel between the XL-RIS and the BS can be described using the Saleh-Valenzuela (SV) model"; the RIS-user paths are also randomly generated (p. 10). Custom simulator; no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 12: "training only on the [3,3] configuration and testing on others"
q3_support: p. 10: "OMP: orthogonal matching pursuit method using a predefined dictionary"; p. 10: "ISTA-Net+: an unrolled network architecture based on the ISTA"; p. 10: "D2-CNN: a data-driven CNN-based channel estimation approach". All compared on NMSE (Fig. 4, p. 10).
q4_support: p. 10: "Table I summarizes the FLOPs and dictionary sizes for each method"
q5_support: p. 10: "The package is available at: https://github.com/facebookresearch/fvcore" is only the FLOP-counting library. The data are self-generated (p. 10); no code or data release of the method is stated.
notes: q2 rests on the [3,3]-trained test of the proposed models on other far/near path splits (p. 12). Fig. 5 changes RIS size, BS antennas and pilots (p. 11) but the paper does not say whether the models were retrained, so it is not used. D2-CNN reuses the PMM of CNN-CDL (p. 10), so ISTA-Net+ is the cleaner learned baseline for q3. XL-RIS near-field model with a spherical wavefront (p. 4).
